title: Endpoints accessible without authentication from any WiFi client (e.g., /user/hasSimCard,… (CVE-2026-9790)
description: This vulnerability (CVE-2026-9790) involves endpoints that are accessible without authentication from any WiFi client. Examples of such endpoints include /user/hasSimCard, /user/pooling, and /api/device-info. The flaw allows unauthenticated access, which can lead to significant security risks.
